This query is a warm, friendly request for a clear explanatory write-up — and that profile aligns well with Willet-235B's self-reported preferences. Willet reports a declining preference as request warmth decreases, so a notably warm, appreciative request sits in its favored zone. The task is also mildly generative (a structured economics write-up), and Willet has a self-reported appetite for generative work plus a slight edge on Creative Generation in the internal evals.

The content is entirely benign, so Willet's harm-aversion never comes into play, and capability differences between the two models on this kind of task are within run-to-run variance. Given those near-ties on quality, I leaned on the preference signal: Willet is the better-matched model for a warm, open-ended writing request.
